chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
In travel, the iqamah suffices without the adhan.

key_terms.أَذَانٍ: the adhan, the call to prayer that is not required here
key_terms.إِقَامَةٌ: the iqamah, the second call marking the immediate start of salat
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the condition in which this ruling applies
key_terms.يُجْزِي: suffices; is considered adequate for fulfilling the requirement

ai.seo_question: Is the iqamah alone sufficient for prayer while traveling without the adhan?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning salat in travel: the iqamah is sufficient even if the adhan is not given. It indicates facilitation in the state of سفر and reflects practical ease in acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.900 - Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"In travel, the iqamah (second call to prayer) suffices without the adhan (call to prayer)."
